_description: Single source of truth for the SHARED prefix / S8-S10 control scalars that several t34 units feed as control blocks. Unit files must not redeclare these keys; t34_score.merged_orientations() treats this file as authoritative for them and reports any unit redeclaration. Directions follow the runner's t33_score ORIENTATIONS where the same quantity exists there (more packing / higher ratio / more dropped => riskier; kept fraction => safer). These are CONTROL rows, never candidates: the sign only fixes which tail of the control counts as risk in the S0/length control comparison. Directions for the kept/gist-token family are -1 (for a fixed history, more kept or gist tokens = less loss = safer; two units independently declared this); count-of-drops / packing / ratio / generated-length families are +1.
